name: labs/nicholasmorrow__zeus
title: ZEUS liquid-handling module (zeus.ZeusModule)
intro: ZEUS liquid-handling module (zeus.ZeusModule), adapted from nicholasmorrow/zeus. It reads `z_position`; runs `initialize`, `move_z`, `pick_tip`, `discard_tip` and 3 more. `initialize`: initialize the Z-drive and the dosing drive (native initZDrive and initDosingDrive). A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/nicholasmorrow__zeus --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/nicholasmorrow__zeus --backend fake --mcp
